text.text_excerpt: I totally walked past Killer Poboys while trying to find it. There is a small sign so keep your eyes open! I came here for lunch. There is limited seating, so I recommend doing take out. I managed to find a table, so decided to eat here. You have to order at the counter, get a number, and wait for your food. They serve alcohol here too! They had a nice selection of local craft beers in the fridge. They also have wines and mimosas! I decided to try the seared gulf shrimp poboy which is flavored with coriander lime, sriracha aioli, daikon, carrot and cucumber. The poboy is quite big, and they are very generous with the amount of filling they put inside. You will be full! My friend had the s...

This was one of my fav meals while visiting New Orleans recently. I had an amazing cauliflower Poboy and was so glad to find a place with veggie Poboy options. The bread was just right and the sandwich was unique and super flavorful. On the menu, this sandwich is served on whole wheat but we opted for french bread. The sandwich has romesco sauce, avocado, radish, and crispy kale. Don't forget the Zapp's chips for the full experience. There are multiple other options on the menu- from the more traditional shrimp to the not so traditional ham & pimento cheese. The service at Killer Poboys was friendly and fast. This was my first Po'boy experience and this place got me hooked! Just don't go here for a first date unless you're willing to get down and messy with this heck of a sandwich :) The restaurant is set up to order at the counter, but your food is served by your server, but definitely do clean up after yourselves though. The service was great and the cashier was pleasant as well. We quickly ordered two Po'boys: Glazed Pork belly and Braised Beef Debris. Glazed Pork Belly- My gosh, this thing is packed with flavors!
